title: Projection off a unit vector preserves nonpositive inner products
statement:
Let $V$ be a real inner product space, and let $u,v,w \in V$ with $\norm{u} = 1$. Suppose the three pairwise inner products $\langle v,w\rangle$, $\langle v,u\rangle$, and $\langle w,u\rangle$ are all nonpositive. For a vector $x \in V$, write $x - \langle u,x\rangle\, u$ for the projection of $x$ onto the orthogonal complement of $\mathrm{span}\{u\}$. Then the projections of $v$ and $w$ again have nonpositive inner product:
\[
\bigl\langle\, v - \langle u,v\rangle\, u,\ \ w - \langle u,w\rangle\, u \,\bigr\rangle \le 0.
\]
replaced:
Let $\norm{u} = 1$ and let $v,w$ satisfy $\langle v,w\rangle \le 0$,
$\langle v,u\rangle \le 0$ and $\langle w,u\rangle \le 0$. Then
$\langle \mathrm{orthProj}(u,v), \mathrm{orthProj}(u,w)\rangle \le 0$.
